name: limit_detail_circle_in_the_margin
why: REPORT 8CD843 N62 (round 20, 28/10/2026). The outline of a view keeps a margin around what it draws: 5.8 mm on each side on the PNG of round 20, 5.9 mm read back in scenario t62 (drawing 103 to 137 mm, outline 97.1 to 142.9 mm). A circle aimed inside the outline but in that margin passed the check «the circle fits» and then enlarged nothing: 0 visible edges (1016c).
defect_caught: That a circle in the margin is drawn, made into a detail and only then found empty; and, the other way round, that a circle taking the end of the part, which sticks out of the box of the drawing as any circle on an edge does, is refused.
_why_these_numbers: The front view of the plate is 120 x 20 mm at scale 1 (detail_enlarges): the drawing goes from x -60 to 60 mm from the centre of the outline, the outline to about 65.9. A circle of radius 2 at x 63 lies between 61 and 65: inside the outline, out of the drawing, 3 mm from its nearest line. The circle of detail_enlarges, radius 8 at x 55, goes from 47 to 63: out of the box of the drawing too, but across the end of the plate.

expect.why: the plate of detail_enlarges: the numbers above are read on its front view
a drawing is made on a saved part
from here on the active document is the drawing
the front view the circles are put on

steps._why_first: THE TWIN THAT PASSES, BEFORE THE REFUSAL: the circle of detail_enlarges sticks out of the box of the drawing, across the end of the plate. A check made on the box alone would refuse it.

expect.why: the right end of the plate, as in detail_enlarges

expect.equal_to: the outline of the view and the lines it draws
expect.why: the lines of the view were read, so the margin could be told from the drawing

expect.tolerance_why: the left end of a plate 120 mm long at scale 1, from the centre of the outline, rounded to a tenth
expect.why: WHAT THE VIEW DRAWS, in the frame of «x_mm» and «y_mm»: the number a plan needs to aim a circle, which «outline_mm» does not give
the other end: a box that only grew on one side would pass the line above

steps._why_refused: THE FIX: refused before anything is drawn, saying where the drawing is. Until library 0.174.9 this circle passed the check on the outline, became a detail and was refused after as empty, «visible edges 0».
